field_discipline: The 'intent' block and the 'observation' block are different kinds of statement and are NEVER merged. 'intent' records what the account holder says a link was created to point at; it can only be filled by a human who has checked Associates Central. 'observation' records what the link actually did when this repository followed it. A destination that is reproducible is still not an intention. Copying an observed ASIN into the intent block is the exact error this register exists to prevent, and a build guard fails the build if it happens (see check_link_intent in build.py).
